description: This file defines a React functional component called 'Tabs' that renders a horizontal tab interface with accessibility features. It accepts props for tabs data, active tab, change handler, styling, and accessibility label. The component maps over the tabs array and generates styled buttons acting as tabs, updating the selected tab via onChange callback.
